summary: Executed backend pytest regression (health + waitlist) and frontend Playwright coverage for homepage, navigation, demo interactions, waitlist modal, all 10 use-case pages, responsiveness, and data-testid audit.
action_items: Optional hardening: handle duplicate-key race in POST /api/waitlist insert path to preserve idempotency under concurrent submits.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/waitlist does check-then-insert; concurrent same-email requests may raise duplicate-key and currently return 500 instead of idempotent already_joined.
CORS is configured with allow_origins=['*'] and allow_credentials=True; this is not recommended for production trust boundary.
test_credentials: Missing /app/memory/test_credentials.md (no auth tests required for this app).
seed_data_creation: Created waitlist test entries via POST /api/waitlist using TEST_ data and unique emails.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core requested flows passed on external preview URL. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_waitlist_api.py and extend for concurrency/idempotency race testing if needed.
rca of the issue: No runtime failures reproduced in requested flows. Code-level RCA risk: waitlist idempotency can break under concurrent requests because duplicate email handling is pre-insert lookup plus broad exception catch on insert. Mitigation: catch Mongo duplicate-key error specifically and return existing record/already_joined response.
